verses.en: The words of God, which he spake unto Moses at a time when Moses was caught up into an exceedingly high mountain,
verses.sm: O afioga a le Atua, na ia fetalai ai ia Mose i le taimi na aveina a’e ai Mose i se mauga maualuga tele lava,

verses.en: And he saw God face to face, and he talked with him, and the glory of God was upon Moses; therefore Moses could endure his presence.
verses.sm: Ma sa vaai faafesagai o ia i le Atua, ma sa la talanoa ma ia, ma sa i luga o Mose le mamalu o le Atua; o lea na mafai ai e Mose ona gafataulimaina lona mamalu.

verses.en: And God spake unto Moses, saying: Behold, I am the Lord God Almighty, and Endless is my name; for I am without beginning of days or end of years; and is not this endless?
verses.sm: Ma sa fetalai mai le Atua ia Mose, ua fai mai: Faauta, o A’u o le Alii le Atua Malosi Aoao, ma e Lē Gata o lo’u igoa lea; ona ua aunoa A’u ma se amataga o aso po o se gataaga o tausaga; ma pe lē o le lē gata ea lea?

verses.en: And, behold, thou art my son; wherefore look, and I will show thee the workmanship of mine hands; but not all, for my works are without end, and also my words, for they never cease.
verses.sm: Ma, faauta, o oe lava o lo’u atalii; o le mea lea ia vaai, ma o le a Ou faaali atu ia te oe galuega a o’u lima; ae lē o galuega uma, aua o a’u galuega ua aunoa ma se gataaga, ma a’u upu foi, aua e lē uma lava i latou.

verses.en: Wherefore, no man can behold all my works, except he behold all my glory; and no man can behold all my glory, and afterwards remain in the flesh on the earth.
verses.sm: O le mea lea, e leai se tagata e mafai ona vaai i a’u galuega uma, vagana ua vaai o ia i lo’u mamalu atoa; ma e leai se tagata e mafai ona vaai i lo’u mamalu atoa, ma tumau pea i la le tino i le lalolagi.

verses.en: And I have a work for thee, Moses, my son; and thou art in the similitude of mine Only Begotten; and mine Only Begotten is and shall be the Savior, for he is full of grace and truth; but there is no God beside me, and all things are present with me, for I know them all.
verses.sm: Ma ua ia te a’u se galuega mo oe, Mose e, lo’u atalii; ma ua tusa oe ma la’u Toatasi na Fanaua; ma o la’u Toatasi na Fanaua o le Faaola ma o le a avea ma Faaola, ona ua tumu o ia i le alofa tunoa ma le upumoni; peitai ua leai se isi Atua e ese mai ia te a’u, ma ua i ai mea uma i o’u luma, ona ua Ou iloa i latou uma.

verses.en: And now, behold, this one thing I show unto thee, Moses, my son, for thou art in the world, and now I show it unto thee.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, faauta, o le mea lenei e tasi Ou te faaali atu ia te oe, Mose e, lo’u atalii; aua o loo e i le lalolagi; ma o le a Ou faaalia atu nei ia te oe.

verses.en: And it came to pass that Moses looked, and beheld the world upon which he was created; and Moses beheld the world and the ends thereof, and all the children of men which are, and which were created; of the same he greatly marveled and wondered.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina vaai atu Mose, ma vaai atu i le lalolagi na foafoa ai o ia i ona luga; ma sa vaaia e Mose le lalolagi ma ona tuluiga, ma le fanauga uma a tagata o i ai, ma e na foafoaina; o lea lava mea sa ofo ma maofa tele ai o ia.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And the presence of God withdrew from Moses, that his glory was not upon Moses; and Moses was left unto himself. And as he was left unto himself, he fell unto the earth.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina afio ese le Atua mai ia Mose, sa oo ina lē i ai lona mamalu i luga o Mose; ma sa tuua Mose ia te ia lava. Ma ina ua tuua o ia ia te ia lava, sa pa’ū ifo o ia i le eleele.

verses.en: And it came to pass that it was for the space of many hours before Moses did again receive his natural strength like unto man; and he said unto himself: Now, for this cause I know that man is nothing, which thing I never had supposed.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina faato’ā toe maua e Mose i le va o itula e tele lona malosi e masani ai e pei lava o le tagata; ma sa fai ifo o ia ia te ia lava: O lenei, ona o lenei mea ua ou iloa ai o le tagata ua le aoga o ia, o se mea ou te le’i mafaufauina lava.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: But now mine own eyes have beheld God; but not my natural, but my spiritual eyes, for my natural eyes could not have beheld; for I should have withered and died in his presence; but his glory was upon me; and I beheld his face, for I was transfigured before him.
verses.sm: A’o lenei ua vaai o’u lava mata i le Atua; ae e lē o o’u mata faaletino, a’o o’u mata faaleagaga, aua sa lē mafai e o’u mata faaletino ona vaaia; po ua ou mamae ma oti i ona luma; ae sa i ai lona mamalu i o’u luga; ma sa ou vaai i ona fofoga, ona sa liua a’u i ona luma.

verses.en: And it came to pass that when Moses had said these words, behold, Satan came tempting him, saying: Moses, son of man, worship me.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina ua uma ona fai atu e Mose nei upu, faauta, sa alu ane Satani ma faaosooso ia te ia, ua fai mai: Mose e, le atalii o le tagata, ifo mai ia te a’u.

verses.en: And it came to pass that Moses looked upon Satan and said: Who art thou? For behold, I am a son of God, in the similitude of his Only Begotten; and where is thy glory, that I should worship thee?
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina vaai atu Mose ia Satani ma fai atu: O ai oe? Aua faauta, o a’u o se atalii o le Atua, i le faatusa o lana Toatasi na Fanaua; ma o fea o i ai lou mamalu, e tatau ai ona ou ifo atu ia te oe?

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: For behold, I could not look upon God, except his glory should come upon me, and I were transfigured before him. But I can look upon thee in the natural man. Is it not so, surely?
verses.sm: Aua faauta, sa lē mafai ona ou vaai atu i le Atua, vagana ua oo mai lona mamalu i o’u luga, ma liua a’u i ona luma. Ae ua mafai ona ou vaai atu ia te oe i le tulaga tagata faaletino. Pe ua lē moni ea lea?

verses.en: Blessed be the name of my God, for his Spirit hath not altogether withdrawn from me, or else where is thy glory, for it is darkness unto me? And I can judge between thee and God; for God said unto me: Worship God, for him only shalt thou serve.
verses.sm: Ia faamanūina lava le suafa o lo’u Atua, ona ua lē alu ese atoa lona Agaga mai ia te a’u, a lē o lea o fea o i ai lou mamalu, aua ua pouliuli ia te a’u? Ma e mafai ona ou iloa le eseesega o oe ma le Atua; ona na fetalai mai le Atua ia te a’u: Ifo atu i le Atua, aua na’o ia lava e te auauna atu i ai.

verses.en: Get thee hence, Satan; deceive me not; for God said unto me: Thou art after the similitude of mine Only Begotten.
verses.sm: Alu ese ia oe, Satani; aua e te taufaasese mai ia te a’u; aua na fetalai mai le Atua ia te a’u: Ua tusa oe ma la’u Toatasi na Fanaua.

verses.en: And he also gave me commandments when he called unto me out of the burning bush, saying: Call upon God in the name of mine Only Begotten, and worship me.
verses.sm: Ma sa ia tuu mai foi ia te a’u poloaiga ina ua fetalai mai o ia ia te a’u i le laau na mu, ua fai mai: Valaau atu i le Atua i le suafa o la’u Toatasi na Fanaua, ma ifo mai ia te a’u.

verses.en: And again Moses said: I will not cease to call upon God, I have other things to inquire of him: for his glory has been upon me, wherefore I can judge between him and thee. Depart hence, Satan.
verses.sm: Ma sa toe fai atu Mose: O le a ou lē tuua le valaau atu i le Atua, ua i ai ia te a’u isi mea e ole atu ai ia te ia: aua sa i ai lona mamalu i o’u luga, o le mea lea ua mafai ai ona ou iloa le eseesega o ia ma oe. Alu ese ia ma iinei, Satani.

verses.en: And now, when Moses had said these words, Satan cried with a loud voice, and ranted upon the earth, and commanded, saying: I am the Only Begotten, worship me.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, ina ua uma ona fai atu e Mose o nei upu, sa alaga Satani ma le leo tele, ma sa leoleoā i luga o le eleele, ma faatonu mai, ua fai mai: O a’u o le Toatasi na Fanaua, ifo mai ia te a’u.

verses.en: And it came to pass that Moses began to fear exceedingly; and as he began to fear, he saw the bitterness of hell. Nevertheless, calling upon God, he received strength, and he commanded, saying: Depart from me, Satan, for this one God only will I worship, which is the God of glory.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina amata ona fefe tele Mose; ma ina ua amata ona fefe o ia, sa vaai o ia i le inosia o seoli. Ae ui i lea, sa maua e ia le malosi, i le valaau atu i le Atua, ma sa ia faatonu atu, e faapea: Satani, alu ese ia mai ia te a’u, aua ua na’o le Atua lenei e tasi o le a ou ifo atu i ai, o le Atua lea o le mamalu.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And now Satan began to tremble, and the earth shook; and Moses received strength, and called upon God, saying: In the name of the Only Begotten, depart hence, Satan.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei sa amata ona gatete Satani, ma sa luluina le eleele; ma sa maua e Mose le malosi, ma valaau atu i le Atua, ua fai atu: I le suafa o le Toatasi na Fanaua, alu ese ia ma iinei, Satani.

verses.en: And it came to pass that Satan cried with a loud voice, with weeping, and wailing, and gnashing of teeth; and he departed hence, even from the presence of Moses, that he beheld him not.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina alaga Satani ma le leo tele, i le tagi, ma le tagiauē, ma le lilivau o nifo; ma sa alu ese o ia mai iina, mai luma lava o Mose, sa oo ina ia lē vaaia o ia.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And now of this thing Moses bore record; but because of wickedness it is not had among the children of men.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei sa molimau ai Mose i lenei mea; ae ona o le amioleaga ua lē i ai ai i totonu o le fanauga a tagata.

verses.en: And it came to pass that when Satan had departed from the presence of Moses, that Moses lifted up his eyes unto heaven, being filled with the Holy Ghost, which beareth record of the Father and the Son;
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina ua alu ese Satani mai luma o Mose, sa tepa a’e mata o Mose i le lagi, ua tumu i le Agaga Paia, lea e molimau e uiga i le Tamā ma le Alo;

verses.en: And calling upon the name of God, he beheld his glory again, for it was upon him; and he heard a voice, saying: Blessed art thou, Moses, for I, the Almighty, have chosen thee, and thou shalt be made stronger than many waters; for they shall obey thy command as if thou wert God.
verses.sm: Ma a’o valaau atu i le suafa o le Atua, sa toe vaaia e ia lona mamalu, aua sa i luga o ia; ma sa ia faalogoina se siufofoga, ua fetalai mai: Amuia lava oe Mose, ona o A’u, o le Malosi Aoao, na filifilia oe, ma o le a faia oe ia e malosi e sili atu nai lo vai e tele, ona o le a latou usiusitai i lau poloai e pei o oe o le Atua.

verses.en: And lo, I am with thee, even unto the end of thy days; for thou shalt deliver my people from bondage, even Israel my chosen.
verses.sm: Ma faauta, Ou te faatasi ma oe, e oo lava i le iuga o ou aso; aua o le a e laveai lo’u nuu mai le nofopologa, o Isaraelu lava lea ua ou filifilia.

verses.en: And it came to pass, as the voice was still speaking, Moses cast his eyes and beheld the earth, yea, even all of it; and there was not a particle of it which he did not behold, discerning it by the Spirit of God.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina a’o fetalai mai pea le siufofoga, sa tepa atu mata o Mose ma vaai atu i le lalolagi, ioe, le lalolagi atoa lava; ma sa leai sona vaega itiiti sa lei vaaia e ia, ma iloatino ai e ala i le Agaga o le Atua.

verses.en: And he beheld also the inhabitants thereof, and there was not a soul which he beheld not; and he discerned them by the Spirit of God; and their numbers were great, even numberless as the sand upon the sea shore.
verses.sm: Ma sa vaai foi o ia i e o nonofo ai, ma sa leai se agaga sa lei vaaia e ia; ma sa iloa e ia i latou e ala i le Agaga o le Atua; ma o o latou aofai sa matua toatele lava, sa lē mafaitaulia lava e pei o le oneone o le matafaga.

verses.en: And he beheld many lands; and each land was called earth, and there were inhabitants on the face thereof.
verses.sm: Ma sa ia vaai i laueleele e tele; ma sa ta’ua ia laueleele taitasi o lalolagi, ma sa i ai ni isi sa nonofo ai.

verses.en: And it came to pass that Moses called upon God, saying: Tell me, I pray thee, why these things are so, and by what thou madest them?
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina valaau atu Mose i le Atua, ua faapea atu: Ou te ole atu ia te oe, sei ta’u mai ia te a’u, pe aisea ua faapea ona i ai o ia mea, ma o a mea na e faia ai i latou?

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And behold, the glory of the Lord was upon Moses, so that Moses stood in the presence of God, and talked with him face to face. And the Lord God said unto Moses: For mine own purpose have I made these things. Here is wisdom and it remaineth in me.
verses.sm: Ma faauta, sa i luga o Mose le mamalu o le Alii, o lea na tulai ai Mose i luma o le Atua, ma talanoa faafesagai ma ia. Ma sa fetalai mai le Alii le Atua ia Mose: E mo la’u lava fuafuaga na Ou faia ai nei mea. O le poto lenei ma e tumau pea ia te a’u.

verses.en: And by the word of my power, have I created them, which is mine Only Begotten Son, who is full of grace and truth.
verses.sm: Ma o le upu a lo’u mana, na Ou foafoa ai i latou, o ia lea o lo’u Atalii Pele e Toatasi, o lē ua tumu i le alofa tunoa ma le upumoni.

verses.en: And worlds without number have I created; and I also created them for mine own purpose; and by the Son I created them, which is mine Only Begotten.
verses.sm: Ma e lē mafaitaulia lalolagi ua Ou foafoaina; ma sa Ou foafoaina foi i latou mo lo’u lava faamoemoe; ma o lo’u Atalii Pele e Toatasi, na Ou foafoaina ai i latou.

verses.en: And the first man of all men have I called Adam, which is many.
verses.sm: Ma o le uluai tagata o tagata uma ua Ou faaigoaina o Atamu, o lona uiga e toatele.

verses.en: But only an account of this earth, and the inhabitants thereof, give I unto you. For behold, there are many worlds that have passed away by the word of my power. And there are many that now stand, and innumerable are they unto man; but all things are numbered unto me, for they are mine and I know them.
verses.sm: Ae ua na’o se tala o le lalolagi lenei, ma e o nonofo ai, Ou te tuu atu ia te oe. Aua faauta, e i ai lalolagi e tele ua mavae atu e ala i le upu a lo’u mana. Ma e i ai le tele o loo tutu nei, ma ua lē mafaitaulia i latou i le tagata; ae ua faitaulia mea uma ia te a’u, aua e a a’u i latou ma ua Ou iloa i latou.

verses.en: And it came to pass that Moses spake unto the Lord, saying: Be merciful unto thy servant, O God, and tell me concerning this earth, and the inhabitants thereof, and also the heavens, and then thy servant will be content.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina fai atu Mose i le Alii, ua faapea atu: Ia e alofa mutimutivale mai i lau auauna, E, le Atua e, ma ta’u mai ia te a’u e uiga i le lalolagi lenei, ma e o nonofo ai, ma le lagi foi, ona malie ai lea o lau auauna.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And the Lord God spake unto Moses, saying: The heavens, they are many, and they cannot be numbered unto man; but they are numbered unto me, for they are mine.
verses.sm: Ma sa fetalai mai le Alii le Atua ia Mose, ua fai mai: O lagi, e tele, ma e lē mafai ona faitaulia i latou i le tagata; ae ua faitaulia i latou ia te a’u, ona e a a’u i latou.

verses.en: And as one earth shall pass away, and the heavens thereof even so shall another come; and there is no end to my works, neither to my words.
verses.sm: Ma e pei ona o le a mavae atu le tasi lalolagi, ma ona lagi o le a faapea foi ona tulai mai se isi; ma e leai se gataaga i a’u galuega, e pei o a’u upu.

verses.en: For behold, this is my work and my glory—to bring to pass the immortality and eternal life of man.
verses.sm: Aua faauta, o la’u galuega ma lo’u mamalu lenei— ia aumaia le tino ola pea ma le ola faavavau o le tagata.

verses.en: And now, Moses, my son, I will speak unto thee concerning this earth upon which thou standest; and thou shalt write the things which I shall speak.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, Mose e, lo’u atalii, o le a Ou tautala atu ia te oe e uiga i le lalolagi lenei o loo e tulai ai; ma ia e tusia mea o le a Ou tautala atu ai.

verses.en: And in a day when the children of men shall esteem my words as naught and take many of them from the book which thou shalt write, behold, I will raise up another like unto thee; and they shall be had again among the children of men—among as many as shall believe.
verses.sm: Ma i se aso e manatu ai le fanauga a tagata i a’u upu o ni meanoa ma aveese le tele o i latou mai le tusi o le a e tusia, faauta, o le a Ou faatulai mai se tasi e pei o oe; ma o le a toe i ai ia mea i totonu o le fanauga a tagata— i totonu o le toatele o e e talitonu.

verses.en: (These words were spoken unto Moses in the mount, the name of which shall not be known among the children of men. And now they are spoken unto you. Show them not unto any except them that believe. Even so. Amen.)
verses.sm: (O upu nei na tulei mai ia Mose i le mauga, o lona igoa o le a lē iloa i totonu o le fanauga a tagata. Ma o lenei ua fetalaia atu ia te oe. Aua ne’i faaali atua i soo se tasi vagana ai i latou o e e talitonu. E faapea lava. Amene.)
